package anthropic // import "github.com/mrsibe/goat/ai/anthropic"

Package anthropic adapts the Anthropic Messages API to the ai model interface.
It uses the official Anthropic Go SDK for requests and streaming.

TYPES

type Config struct {
	APIKey          string
	BaseURL         string
	Model           string
	Provider        string
	HTTPClient      *http.Client
	MaxRetries      *int
	ContextWindow   int
	MaxOutputTokens int
}
    Config configures an Anthropic Messages model.

type Provider struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Provider implements ai.Model using Anthropic Messages streaming.

func New(config Config) (*Provider, error)
    New creates an Anthropic Messages provider.

func (p *Provider) Info() ai.ModelInfo
    Info implements ai.Model.

func (p *Provider) Stream(ctx context.Context, request ai.Request) (ai.Stream, error)
    Stream starts one streamed Messages request.
